_comment: Scoring + lifecycle rules for the Caller ID Reputation Monitor. L1 = our OWN outbound call outcomes (the behavioral, ground-truth spam signal: a number whose answer rate craters is a labeled number). Default L1 source is SmrtPhone's own call log (smrtphone_cdr.py) - works for any SmrtPhone user with zero telecom setup. L2 = Telnyx Number Reputation (carrier-grade) is OPTIONAL and OFF unless a Telnyx key + enterprise_id are configured (requires porting the numbers into a Telnyx account + account verification - heavy, opt-in only). IPQS (the old proxy) is RETIRED. See REPUTATION-WORKFLOW.md.
_l1_source_note: 'smrtphone' (default) reads per-number ASR/ALOC/short% from the SmrtPhone call log over a trailing window - no port, no Telnyx, no fee. 'telnyx' reads Telnyx CDR (only works once the DIDs are ported into your own Telnyx account + TELNYX_API_KEY is set).
_window_note: Trailing days of SmrtPhone calls to aggregate per number. 7 gives each DID a stable ~200+ dial sample instead of a noisy single day. Raise for smoother signal, lower for faster reaction.

l1_cdr._note: SmrtPhone's own published healthy targets. A breach makes a DID at least Watch (early warning). min_dials gates the metric: below it the sample is too small to judge, so L1 abstains (avoids flagging a warm-up number on a few calls). NOTE: short_call_max_pct is a weak signal on the SmrtPhone source - its `duration` does not capture sub-6s connects, so short% reads ~0 and never false-flags; ASR and ALOC carry the detection. Telnyx CDR captures short calls properly.

l2_reputation._note: Telnyx Number Reputation aggregate (no per-carrier breakdown exists). spam_category non-null (a real label) -> Flagged; spam_risk high -> Flagged; medium -> Watch; low -> Clean. Fresh (billable) rechecks fire ONLY on DIDs a cheaper layer already degraded, capped per run.

fusion._note: status(DID) = worst of {L1, L2}. Carrier-grade L2 can flag even when L1 is clean; L1 breach forces at least Watch. Neither layer can veto the other DOWN (worst-of never lowers).

lifecycle._note: State machine per DID (distinct from the fused status). See REPUTATION-WORKFLOW.md section 5.
lifecycle._watch_cap_note: A WATCH DID stays dialable at this reduced cap (default ~half of active) so its own call traffic keeps producing L1 CDR data and it can clear itself back to ACTIVE. Benching it entirely would strand it off-pool with no traffic to re-score it. RESTING/RETIRED are fully benched.
lifecycle._trend_note: If a DID reads non-Clean (Watch or worse) this many checks in a row, escalate to Flagged even when no single reading is critical. Catches a slow degrade.
lifecycle._recovered_note: RESTING -> ACTIVE only after rest_days elapsed AND a fresh (billable) L2 check reads clean AND the root cause was addressed. Resting alone does not clear a carrier flag.

remediation._note: Auto-files a Telnyx remediation request on any NEW Flagged. 14-day per-number cooldown is enforced by Telnyx (a number in cooldown lands in the 'ineligible' bucket, not an error). call_purpose is sent verbatim to the analytics network.
remediation.call_purpose: Outbound real estate offers to property owners who requested or may benefit from a cash offer.

_recheck_note: Free Caller Registry has NO real renewal cadence (register once). This is a quarterly calendar reminder to re-verify status and re-submit only on the real triggers: a re-labeled number, new/recycled numbers, or a business-name/branding/category change. recheck_by auto-fills to submitted + registration_recheck_days.
_quota_note: Legacy IPQS batch control - unused in the Telnyx-only build (L1 CDR reads the WHOLE pool for free every run, no per-number quota needed). Kept at 0 for back-compat with older monitor code paths.
